teaching.example: We look at maps in geography class.
teaching.example_zh: 我们在地理课上看地图。

extra_examples.en: I like geography because I like maps.
extra_examples.zh: 我喜欢地理，因为我喜欢地图。

teaching.student_prompt: 在地球仪上找一片海洋，说说 geography 会研究什么。
teaching.cloze: We look at maps in __________ class.
teaching.cloze_zh: 我们在地理课上看地图。
teaching.note: 原创 KET 课堂例句；先读单词与例句，再学习构词或常用搭配。

word_study.explanation_zh: geo- 和“地球、大地”有关，-graphy 和“书写、描述”有关。合起来，geography 带我们认识地球上的地方。
word_study.origin_zh: 这个名字来自“描述大地”的意思。想象给地球画一张地图，就容易记住了。

family.connection_zh: 与 geography 同一家族，表示研究地理的人。

example.zh: 这位地理学家研究这条河流。

family.connection_zh: 也有 -graphy；photo- 与光有关，摄影用光记录画面。

challenge.prompt_zh: 和 geography 一样，带有 -graphy 的词还能想到哪个？

images.alt: 两个孩子一起观察地球仪和没有文字标注的世界地形图。
images.caption: We look at maps in geography class.
images.prompt: undefinedPrimary request: Two fully clothed fictional primary-school children around nine in a sunlit classroom studying a large realistic globe and a spread-out physical world map with correctly recognisable continent silhouettes. One points to the globe and the other traces a river on the map. Maps have natural blue seas and green/brown land, NO printed place names, labels, writing, flags or invented symbols. Geography as learning about places on Earth, clear globe as central subject, beautiful real educational photography.
